note: POOLED is delivered only by the pooled edition '2016 - 2018', under a version label no book lists, so only book a's `[[binding.variable]]` override names a book for it. The override binds the one pooled state over the whole pooled range, like pooled coding (Y-207).
fails_if: `apply_classification_cases` (source_classification_bindings.py) reads the override's occurrence windows with `scope_bounds`, which leaves a pooled scope unbounded, instead of the pooled-aware `_column_evidence`: POOLED loses 'a' and the override binds nothing

sources.description: SCB VALUE (2020) and POOLED, whose only edition is the pooled '2016 - 2018' carrying codes 1/2 under the value-set version 'Pooled report'; book a with codes 1/2 overrides scb/sample/pooled.
